tactics: induction h with | nil => simp | cons x _ ih => simpa using ih.append_left x | swap x y l => simpa [← List.append_assoc] using (List.perm_append_comm (l₁ := y) (l₂ := x)).append_right l.flatten | trans _ _ ih1 ih2 => exact ih1.trans ih2

induction h with | nil => exact List.Perm.refl _ | cons x _ ih => exact ih.append_left x | swap x y l => (simp only [List.flatten_cons, ← List.append_assoc]; exact List.perm_append_comm.append_right _) | trans _ _ ih1 ih2 => exact ih1.trans ih2

induction h with | nil => simp | cons x _ ih => simp [ih] | swap x y l => simp only [List.flatten_cons, ← List.append_assoc]; exact List.perm_append_comm.append_right _ | trans _ _ ih1 ih2 => exact ih1.trans ih2
